feedback_driven.quote: We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm

persists_across_tasks.quote: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass.

data.why_zh: 论文利用测试反馈演化测试套件作为自演化 agent 的环内验证器
